newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon wins $270 mln for coke plants.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon wins $270 mln for coke plants.

text.p: Raytheon Co's unit, Raytheon Engineers & Constructors, said on Tuesday it received awards worth $270 million for coke plant projects in the United States and India.
The company said it would be responsible for services for both the coke facilities and associated cogeneration power plants at the two sites.
The first project, worth more than $180 million to Raytheon, is for a 1.33 million tons per year coke plant at Inland Steel Co's Indiana Harbor Works steel plant in East Chicago, Ind.

The company said its project in India, which is worth about $60 million to Raytheon, is for a 675,000 tons per year coke plant for Bellary Coke & Power Ltd at a site near Gummidi Poondi in Tamil Nadu.
Raytheon said it will provide engineering, procurement, and construction advisory services for the coke facility and related 60 megawatt cogeneration plant.
